_comment: The `policy-enforce` world — `policy-default` with `control_plane_auth: enforce` and NOTHING else changed (specs/worlds/README.md), for the GW-SESSIONS-AUTH enforce rows only. The rest of this comment is policy-default's: the TEST policy (specs/worlds/README.md). Namespaces and Secret names are fixture names. Model ids are copied verbatim from argocd/resources/openrouter-proxy/model-classes.json (`models.*.ids` per rail; the `coding` class chain_head order for openrouter) — never invented. Rail caps: opencode = 3 mirrors that file's declared `rails.opencode-go.concurrency`; anthropic 5 and openrouter 20 are fixture sizes. `side_models` (anthropic) = the family claude-code's small side-calls name (ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL), admitted on every session of that rail (⚖ GW-MODEL-RESOLVE). Every key here is one the gateway reads; a fact the policy cannot hold yet rides as a ⚖ comment in the spec, never as an invented key.

admission._comment: ⚖ the old proxy's values, copied (sessions.md §Capacity): utilization_thresholds 5h = ANTHROPIC_UTIL_THRESHOLD's code default 0.80 (openrouter-proxy.py; unset in its deployment.yaml), 7d = ANTHROPIC_UTIL_THRESHOLD_7D 0.95 (deployment.yaml); latch_429_hold_s = ANTHROPIC_429_HOLD_S 900. reading_stale_s 900 has NO old-proxy precedent (it only drops a reading whose reset passed) — the gateway's own guess, ⚖.

⚖ copied from argocd/resources/openrouter-proxy/gometer.py (snapshot 2026-09-17) — a DUPLICATE until the old proxy retires: latch_429_hold_s = openrouter-proxy.py GO_CAPACITY_HOLD_S 900; prices = GO_PRICES / GO_PRICES_PEAK rows for the policy's priced Go model ($/M; null = gometer's None, draws 0); fallback = _GO_MAX_PRICE/2 each for in/out (max in+out = kimi-k3 3.00+15.00), cache 0 — what an unpriced id (claude-sonnet-4-6) draws at; peak hours = GO_PEAK_HOURS_UTC / GO_PEAK_WEEKDAYS; windows = _GO_WINDOW_DEFAULTS (budgets 12/30/60, anchors chain/weekly mon 00:00/monthly 13 11:30; GO_WINDOW_ANCHORS unset in deployment.yaml) with threshold = OPENCODE_UTIL_THRESHOLD's code default 0.80 (unset in deployment.yaml).

context_tokens._comment: per-model harness window, copied from model-classes.json `models.*.context_tokens` — the only non-null entry today is the Go rail's deepseek-v4-flash; absent = null in the dispatch answer, never a guess.

callers._comment: GW-SESSIONS-AUTH — fixture identities (specs/worlds/README.md): the platform loop's dispatcher (worker admissions bound into its fixture worker namespace) and the specs reviewer's tick (reviewer + the worker-role shadow cell, never a bind), and a JUDGE (GW-SESSIONS-OUTCOME: admits nothing, `outcome: any` — may report an outcome on any platform session). The same two callers as `policy-default`; here a caller with no valid token is refused.
